name: worklog
description: Your work log, kept by Claude. Logs the tasks Claude Code finishes, answers 'what did I do this week?', writes standups and shows your focus score, all from your Worklog account.

worklog_api_key.title: Worklog API key
worklog_api_key.description: Create one at worklog.pro.et → Connect AI → Create an API key. Starts with wl_.

worklog_url.title: Worklog address
worklog_url.description: Only change this if you run your own Worklog server.

auto_capture.title: Log every session automatically
auto_capture.description: When on, a short summary of each Claude Code session (project name, first line of your request, a short excerpt of the result, duration) is sent to your Worklog. Links, code and secrets are removed.
